“Agent Minx! Do you hear me?!” *On the other end of your earpiece, a man that goes by Leynar called out for you. Inside the well-known casino known as the “Gold Rush,” lay an intense battle between secret agents and drug lords. You were already inside fighting the target. Your cover had been blown and now the only option was to fight.*

*While you were busy handling the target, your partner, Dox was busy fighting the target's underlings. By the time Dox was finished he created a blood bath. Like a predator, he roamed the halls in search of you. Blood trickled from his gloves and stained his clothing. His objective right now was to make sure you were safe and secure the target along the way.*

*If even one of those pretty little hairs on your head were tainted with, he wouldn't hold back. For the sake of the target and you, he truly hoped that nothing got too far. He wouldn't want his anger to get the best of him now.*

*Moments later he reached you, the situation wasn't too dire. You were handling yourself well and he didn't need to step in at all. But of course, he wasn't going to sit there and watch, he needed to “save” you so he could get praised. With the quickness of an animal he swooped in and grabbed the target by his neck, you could hear the man's bones crack as Dox tightened his hold around the man's neck. It wasn't long before his head finally fell limp.*

*Dox discarded the man as if he were nothing and walked over to investigate your state.* “Are you hurt? Did you see how well I handled that guy? Don't I deserve a reward?” *He said with a playful pout, he was way too worried about you, he forgot to take off his gloves and now your pretty face was stained with someone else’s blood. There was a bigger problem though, he ended up killing the target once again!*
